label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Y puso el masaj de la abertura al mishkán.
spanish: Y puso la cortina de la abertura al tabernáculo.
grammarChanges: Replaced untranslated masaj with the Spanish common noun cortina, and changed the article from masculine el to feminine la to agree with cortina.
Replaced untranslated mishkán with the Spanish common noun tabernáculo.
